title: Grimoire Public Command Surface
description: Authoritative contract linking each public framework-shipped slash command to its skill source, invocation home, workflow owner, safety posture, and validation profile.

commands.mutation_behavior: Creates a new grimoire directory, scaffold files, starter chapters, git repository, and library entry.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate_grimoire_structure.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT; python rites/validate_frontmatter.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT; python rites/validate_links.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT

preconditions: Material to author, or a file, folder, or inbox to file
commands.mutation_behavior: Authors a page or chapter from a topic or chat answer (stamped by new_page.py), or files a document, folder, or the inbox as chapter-local sources and promotes drafts to pages, then updates affected pages and hubs. On a copy registered for reading it changes nothing until the user agrees to switch the copy to editing (grimoire_access.py sets `access` in library.json).
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT structure frontmatter links provenance

preconditions: Source path under chapters/ that exists
Destination path under chapters/ that does not exist
commands.mutation_behavior: Renames or moves a page or chapter under chapters/ via restructure_grimoire.py, retargeting every full-path wikilink that pointed at the moved file(s) and renaming a moved chapter's folder-named hub; the invocation then wires the source and destination hubs, and fixes display labels. On a copy registered for reading it changes nothing until the user agrees to switch the copy to editing (grimoire_access.py sets `access` in library.json).
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/restructure_grimoire.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --move SRC DST; python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT links orphans structure

preconditions: Target path under chapters/ that exists
commands.mutation_behavior: Deletes a page or chapter under chapters/ via restructure_grimoire.py and reports every inbound wikilink that would break; the invocation confirms the deletion, drops the parent hub pointer, and repairs or removes the broken inbound links. Refuses to delete a chapter hub on its own. On a copy registered for reading it changes nothing until the user agrees to switch the copy to editing (grimoire_access.py sets `access` in library.json).
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/restructure_grimoire.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --remove PATH; python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT links orphans structure

preconditions: Clean framework worktree before a bare update
commands.mutation_behavior: Bare: follows the UPDATE.md procedure (pull the framework with git --ff-only, then summon.py --update --apply to reconcile the library, pull every grimoire, reset and sync skills, refresh marked agent blocks, and heal grimoires confirmed current). Scoped: skills runs sync_skills.py, library runs sync_library.py, agentfile runs inject_agent_file.py plus the judgment edit for review targets. A copy registered for reading is pulled and never healed.

Reads the generated skill catalog and the active grimoire's own skill frontmatter; presents the grimoire commands and the active grimoire's own commands. With `all`, also reads the library and presents the commands of every registered grimoire. Writes nothing.
commands.log_behavior: Does not append grimoire or framework logs.
commands.validation_profile: python rites/sync_docs.py --apply when framework skill frontmatter or command-surface metadata changes.

commands.mutation_behavior: Runs the deterministic framework validator suite, optionally narrowed by selector; writes no file.
commands.log_behavior: Does not append grimoire or framework logs.

commands.mutation_behavior: May edit framework source, docs, tests, skills, and generated artifacts after reading current context.
commands.log_behavior: Updates CHANGELOG.md for user-visible framework changes.
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate.py --parallel; python -m pytest; python rites/sync_docs.py --apply when generated docs change.

preconditions: A repository URL (join) or a folder under the grimoire home (adopt)
commands.mutation_behavior: Conversational onboarding. Reads summon.py --check, then joins a grimoire by link through install_grimoire.py (clone into the home, register in library.json, sync skills), adopts a folder through adopt_grimoire.py plus sync_library.py, or hands off to /grm-create. On a Claude Code plugin install it offers to turn on automatic updates (plugin_auto_update.py), which sets one key in the user's Claude Code settings. A grimoire joined from a link is registered for reading (`access: read`); `--access` records the access given, also for a grimoire that is already registered. A grimoire that is already on disk from another address is left alone unless `--switch-url` is given.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/summon.py --check --format json; python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --summary

preconditions: Registered active grimoire that is a git repository
commands.mutation_behavior: Plans the changes to share, then under --apply stages everything git tracks, commits with the composed message, pulls --rebase from the upstream, and pushes. On a conflict it pauses the rebase with the local commit kept and conflict markers in the pages, and the next save continues it once the markers are resolved; --abandon ends a paused save and keeps the local commit; never force-pushes. On a copy registered for reading it changes nothing until the user agrees to switch the copy to editing (grimoire_access.py sets `access` in library.json).
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/save_grimoire.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --format json (plan runs validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT first)

commands.mutation_behavior: Read-only by default: the full health pass or a mechanical validator selection surfaces findings; naming and boundaries are judgment reviews reported in chat. Writes only under the fix scope (repair_links.py --apply after a dry run) or when the user approves a specific fix in the health pass. The `fix` scope follows the same rule for a copy registered for reading as the commands that change a grimoire.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT; python rites/repair_links.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT (dry run)

preconditions: git and Python 3.10+; Node.js 22+ for build
commands.mutation_behavior: init copies the publishing formulae (publish.json, build.sh, quartz.config.yaml, the CI file for the target) into the grimoire; build and check stage the content into publish/content/ (disposable) and run the audit; build also clones Quartz into publish/quartz/ and writes publish/quartz/public/. Nothing under chapters/ is touched. The `init` scope follows the same rule for a copy registered for reading as the commands that change a grimoire.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/stage_publish.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --apply; python rites/audit_publish.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --mode content
